item.title: “合作”纯属扯淡
item.description:
📝 They moved when they were ordered and they held their positions, and they mimicked the outward appearance of a soldier in battle - but shoot, they did not. Marshall's riflemen were ordinary people responding to the diffusion of responsibility that happens inside any group. Communication overhead grows faster than headcount, coordination costs compound, and every new person contributes their capacity along with their relationships to everyone else.

item.title: Palantir 扩大业务范围至英国各州，获得 FCA 敏感数据

item.title: 改写信息规则的 IBM 科学家刚刚获得图灵奖
item.description:
📝 “贝内特帮助建立的领域基于信息遵循物理规则的理念，其中可能包括量子物理学。IBM 物理学家罗尔夫·兰道尔 (Rolf Landauer) 将贝内特招入公司，他在 1961 年发表的一篇颇具争议性的论文中对此提出了挑战，认为信息从根本上来说是物理的，并遵循热力学定律。在此基础上，贝内特在 1973 年的一篇论文中表明，计算原则上可以可逆地进行，向前运行，然后再运行。在没有任何净能量成本的情况下向后移动，揭示了物理学和信息之间的深层联系，这是大多数科学家没有看到的。
🔤 Original: The IBM scientist who rewrote the rules of information just won a Turing Award
🔗 Read more: https://www.ibm.com/think/news/ibm-scientist-charles-bennett-turing-award
